# FrontierX Legal and Release Instructions

Read `Conquest Source License.txt` and `LEGAL.md` before making the change. If requirements conflict,
the unmodified controlling license wins.

- FrontierX and every distributed derivative remain under the exact non-commercial Conquest source
  license. Do not add another project-wide license or conflicting downstream terms.
- Record each dependency's provenance, exact version, license, modification status, and distribution
  basis. Technical compatibility alone is insufficient.
- Keep `MODIFICATIONS.md` current with the public author identity, date, and material change before
  conveying source or binaries.
- Include the complete controlling license, notices, and modification record in every package.
- Never request or accept payment, donations, expense reimbursement, fees, or other consideration
  for the Program, derivative, distribution, warranty, or support.
- Do not commit or package retail executables, DLLs, installers, keys, media, maps, missions,
  textures, audio, video, manuals, SDK redistributables, or separately obtained patches.
- Keep `binkw32.dll` and `Conquest_Frontier_Wars_Manual.pdf` outside project history and releases
  unless documented redistribution permission is obtained.
- Keep raw binaries, disassembler databases, decompiler projects, memory dumps, traces, and copied
  implementation text outside the repository. Store only minimal interoperability facts and
  independently written code allowed by `LEGAL.md`.

Stop publication of an affected artifact when provenance or license compatibility cannot be
confirmed. Document the blocker; do not infer permission from availability in another repository.
